_rewrites_why: TWO FAMILIES OF FILES ARE NOT SHIPPED TO THE CDN ANY MORE, they are read
from GitHub when somebody asks for one. Between them they were 131,345 of
web/data/profiles/**      65,536   the message count on a profile card
web/data/*/_meta.json     65,809   the room history range on the hire page
A CDN copy of those buys nothing. They are read one at a time, by hash or
by room name, and the reader wants the CURRENT one — which the deployed
copy never was, because it froze at whatever the last publish carried.
Four of this project's own functions already read the archive this way
(api/orders, api/profile, api/recent, api/accept); this is the same idea
applied to the two paths the browser asks for directly.
The URLs the pages use do not change. A rewrite is server-side, so it is
still same-origin as far as the browser and the CSP are concerned, and
GitHub's own cache headers let Vercel's edge hold each file for a few
minutes rather than fetching it per visitor.
WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE: room-snapshots/ and the top-level files.
That is the offline fallback — what /api/city and /api/room serve when
Technocore refuses — and a fallback that needs a third party to be up is
not a fallback. It is 90 small files. It stays in the deployment.

_why: A PUSH TO main MUST NOT START A DEPLOYMENT, and this is the only place
that can stop it. Measured on the September invoice: 20d 8h 34m of build
CPU in ten days, which on a two-core machine is 24.4 hours of building
per DAY. The archiver commits every five minutes and a deployment of
this repository takes about five, so Vercel was building continuously,
ignoreCommand could never have fixed it: Vercel clones the repository
and THEN runs the ignore script, so the money is spent before the script
is asked. deploymentEnabled is decided before any of that happens.
Deployments are now asked for deliberately, in two places, both of them
events rather than cron because cron on this repository delivered 11
.github/workflows/archive.yml  the hourly publish of fresh archive data
Both POST the same Vercel deploy hook, held in the VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK
secret. With no secret set, nothing deploys automatically at all and
both places say so in the log rather than failing.
